conditions.displayName: Data Access audit-log ingest > 350 MB/day (the +$5/mo S1a bound)

displayName: SIG — Data Access audit-log daily volume

documentation.content: The GCS Data Access audit logs (P37.4b, SIG-SEC-005, G1-13) are ingesting above the recorded +$5/mo (S1a) upper bound — ≈350 MB/day at the $0.50/GiB Cloud Logging tier beyond the free allotment. Check the exempted-members set and the sink filter before raising the threshold: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"' --project {project} --freshness=24h`. The cost read the contract names lives in the restricted-access leg's state dir (prestate + cost legs).
